statement_blocker: The repository supplies a cryptosystem label and purpose, not a binder-complete theorem. It does not choose construction, all-message round-trip correctness, signature correctness, efficiency, private-key recovery, factoring hardness, or a modern security claim; nor does it fix prime distinctness, exponent congruence, message domain, modular representation, padding, adversary/cost model, exact conclusion, or boundary cases. Choosing textbook RSA correctness or security would change the received target without accountable source redirection.
target_decision: redirect the catalog system label to one corrected, immutable, independently reviewed source proposition before ordinary statement or proof execution
